archetypes.name: denominator-tracing
archetypes.rationale: The plan has a multi-script integer accounting chain (STATIC_SLOT_COUNT → --intended-slots → threshold comparison) explicitly listed as a failure mode; no static reviewer traces this handoff numerically across scripts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the integer denominator chain from dispatch-panel.sh through review-core.sh to check-reviewer-failure-threshold.sh: verify the plan specifies exactly who computes STATIC_SLOT_COUNT, what value review-core.sh passes as --intended-slots, and whether the threshold computation correctly scales for 4-slot, 8-slot, and mixed-vendor cases. Check whether DYNAMIC_SLOTS and SLOT_COUNT are specified to be derived from manifest line count versus accumulated counters, and confirm the plan avoids a double-count or off-by-one when both-vendor dynamic rows are added. Confirm the plan specifies consistent behavior when a vendor is partially available so that never-launched slots do not inflate the denominator. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: vendor-mirror-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan instructs mirroring dispatch-plan-review-panel.sh's no-duplicate-fallback semantics but does not confirm whether the --no-fallback mechanism or equivalent actually exists in the codebase; a missing primitive would leave the plan incomplete as written.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the plan's both-vendor emission specification is complete by checking whether the mechanism for disabling Phase-2 Codex fallback on Cursor rows (described as '--no-fallback / equivalent') actually exists in the codebase or is explicitly designated as a new addition. Check whether the plan covers dynamic slots' no-duplicate-fallback semantics as thoroughly as static slots, since the failure mode for 'Cursor fails while Codex peer row already launched' applies equally to dynamic rows. Confirm the plan specifies what happens to the no-fallback setting when CODEX_AVAILABLE changes between the static and dynamic emission phases of the same run. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: reversal-risk-audit
archetypes.rationale: The plan deliberately reverses #2449's Codex removal; incomplete cleanup of that prior decision leaves contradictory comments, stale guards, or dead flags that create maintainer confusion even if runtime behavior is correct.
archetypes.prompt_body: Identify every code artifact from #2449's Codex-removal that the plan must address: the codex_present_for_waterfall flag in check-reviewer-failure-threshold.sh, any 'Codex removed in #2449' comments across the scope files, dead code paths gated on that flag, and any docs that characterize the removal as intentional policy. Verify the plan explicitly names each such artifact and states whether it is removed, updated, or repurposed — a plan that re-enables Codex without removing or updating stale contrary guards is incomplete as written. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
